records.description: It's dangerous to go alone... Take ten friends.
records.name: The More the Merrier

records.description: A vast steppe, voracious ogres and dried out salt seas - you really know every corner of Krailos now.
records.name: The Ogre Steppe

records.description: The gnomes decided their pigs need some exclusive diet and you had to do all the dirty work - but wasn't the piglet adorable? <sigh>
records.name: The Picky Pig

records.description: He seriously stored away a wallnut? That was a nutty professor indeed.
records.name: The Professor's Nut

records.description: By setting the right tone you convinced a crystal wolf to accompany you. Remember it is made of crystal, though, so be careful in a banshee's presence.
records.name: The Right Tone

records.description: Traversing the innards of Podzilla was a conquest in and by itself, thanks to Two Lips you are now one with the plant biosphere as you stride its many intertwined trails.
records.name: The Rootwalker

records.description: You almost feel as cool as a raccoon. Now, where's the trash?
records.name: The Rule of Raccool

records.description: You made a knot with Gorgo's living curls and took her scalp. You couldn't save her countless petrified victims, but at least you didn't become one.
records.name: The Serpent's Bride

records.description: You love the winter. Fully equipped with scarf and gloves, you like to have fun outside while building lots of snowmen with your friends. Snowball fight, anyone?
records.name: The Snowman

records.description: Withstanding both filth and desolation of the rotten darkness that corrupted the very core of this world, you embodied the weapon of purity and light to defy all that was tainted. This spirit will continue guide you on all future paths.
records.name: The Spirit of Purity

records.description: You and your shovel - a match made in heaven. Or hell, for that matter. Somewhere down below in any case. You're magically attracted by stone piles and love to open them up and see where those holes lead you. Good biceps as well.
records.name: The Undertaker

records.description: It's unstoppable! Walls? Fortresses? Obstacles? Objections? Pah! Nothing will stand before the stampor. Arrows and spears bounce off its hide, enemies are trampled by the dozen. Just don't go for the subtle approach or a date on this thing.
records.name: Thick-Skinned

records.description: You figured out the right order of spells in the buried cathedral, how enchanting!
records.name: Tied the Knot

records.description: You assisted a very prominent fae and you fought tooth and nail to earn this title.
records.name: Toothfairy Assistant

records.description: You've proven yourself as a worthy member of the 'family' and successfully carried out numerous spy missions for your 'uncle' to support the Venorean traders and their goals.
records.name: Top AVIN Agent

records.description: Girl power! Whether you're female or not, you've proven absolute loyalty and the willingness to put your life at stake for the girls brigade of Carlin.
records.name: Top CGB Agent

records.description: Conspiracies and open secrets are your daily bread. You've shown loyalty to the Thaian crown through your courage when facing enemies and completing spy missions. You're an excellent field agent of the TBI.
records.name: Top TBI Agent

records.description: Wyda seems to be really, really bored. You also found out that she doesn't really need all those blood herbs that adventurers brought her. Still, she was nice enough to take one from you and gave you something quite cool in exchange.
records.name: Torn Treasures

records.description: You proudly wear the traditional Orcsoberfest garb, same as it ever was and as it always will be.
records.name: Traditionalist

records.description: You've discovered a trail of giant footprints and terrified elephants running everywhere. Could it be that the mysterious ape god is rambling in the jungle?
records.name: Trail of the Ape God

records.description: You, Sir or Lady, are a true alchemist. Conducting transmutating experiments to find every possible combination has been your secret passion since years and the results of your research are incredible. Science has just taken a leap thanks to you!
records.name: Transmutator

records.description: You wandered the world of Tibia in search of the ancient dragons' hoards. You are sure, you found them all.
records.name: Treasure Hunter

records.description: Braving a hive full of unimaginable proportions and its grotesque creatures on the surface is only one side of Gray Beach. Your full trip of the island also included a dive into the black nothingness of the deep sea, facing the wrath of the Njey.
records.name: Trip to the Beach

records.description: You and your friends showed the three wizards your loyalty three times - I am sure at least one of them is probably eternally thankful and exceedingly proud of you.
records.name: True Colours

records.description: You conquered the demon challenge and prevailed... now show off your success in style!
records.name: True Dedication

records.description: You're one of the most dedicated Lightbearers - without you, the demons would have torn the veil between the worlds for sure. You've lit each and every basin, travelling high and low, pushing back the otherworldly forces. Let there be light!
records.name: True Lightbearer

records.description: You told Jack the truth by explaining you and Spectulus made a mistake when trying to convince him of being a completely different person.
records.name: Truth Be Told

records.description: You served Yalahar - but you didn't seem so sure whom to believe on the way. Both Azerus and Palimuth had good reasons for their actions, and thus you followed your gut instinct in the end, even if you helped either of them. May Yalahar prosper!
records.name: Turncoat

records.description: A journey through a dreamscape of evil is no small feat. Yet you traversed the nightmarish lands of Roshamuul and live to tell the tale. Don't fall asleep now...
records.name: Twisted Dreams

records.description: You've slain Esmeralda, the most hideous and aggressive of the mutated rats. No one will know that you almost lost a finger in the process.
records.name: Twisted Mutation

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your bow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Archer

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your hammer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Berserker

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your slayer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Bladelord

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your mace into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Brawler

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your chopper into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Executioner

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your spellbook into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Harbinger

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your axe into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Headsman

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your crossbow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Marksman

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform all kinds of weapons into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world. Respect!
records.name: Umbral Master

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your katar into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Redeemer

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your blade into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Swordsman

records.description: You defeated the manifestation of Goshnar's evil traits by fighting your way through beasts you didn't even want to imagine. It transformed you and now you can also look the part.
records.name: Unleash the Beast

records.description: Wow - what was that? You don't know how you ended up here, but somehow you did. How to get from Beregar to Kazordoon in a jiffy - that's something those dwarves would love to know, but you're not quite sure how to reproduce it.
records.name: Unlikely Pathfinder

records.description: Putting this candle stump on your new mount was kind of a waiting game. You're even tempted to call it whack-a-mole. But in the end you found a loyal companion for your journeys into the depths.
records.name: Up the Molehill

records.description: Aren't you just perfectly, wonderfully, beautifully gorgeous? You can't pass a mirror without admiring your looks. Or maybe doing a quick check whether something's stuck in your teeth, perhaps?
records.name: Vanity

records.description: And so it begins!
records.name: Verminbane

records.description: You've always been a rebel - admit it! Supplying prisoners, caring for outcasts, stealing from the rich and giving to the poor - no wait, that was another story.
records.name: Vive la Resistance

records.description: After a long journey and dedication you were favoured by fortune and have tamed all three elusive beasts of the vortex. Unless the Vortexion decides you're a tasty morsel you can enjoy your small stable of ravaging beasts from beyond.
records.name: Vortex Tamer

records.description: You saw the Crystal Gardens with all their stunning beauty and survived the equally impressive monsters there. In the end you discovered a great evil and destroyed it with the help of a banshee who was not even aware of her support.
records.name: Wail of the Banshee

records.description: You're proficient in the darker ways of magic and are usually found sitting inside a circle of candles and skulls muttering unspeakable words. Don't carry things too far or the demons might come get you.
records.name: Warlock

records.description: You sent the Obliverator into oblivion in the arena of Svargrond and defeated nine other dangerous enemies on the way. All hail the Warlord of Svargrond!
records.name: Warlord of Svargrond

records.description: Combining unabating courage in combat and respect for the traditions and culture of the ancient Iks earned you the honours of true Aucar.
records.name: Warrior of the Iks

records.description: One thing's for sure: You definitely love swimming. Hanging out on the beach with your friends, having ice cream and playing beach ball is splashingly good fun!
records.name: Waverider

records.description: Shaking your rattle and dancing around the fire to jungle drums sounds like something you like doing. Besides, dreadlocks are a convenient way to wear your hair - no combing required!
records.name: Way of the Shaman

records.description: This fiery beast really tried to give you hell. But not even a magma crawler can resist a mug of spicy, hot glow wine. Skol!
records.name: Way to Hell

records.description: Dragon dreams are golden.
records.name: Wayfarer

records.description: Alas! What could be more beautiful and satisfying than bringing two loving hearts together? So romantic!
records.name: Wedding Planner

records.description: You helped Domizian and thus proved yourself worthy to enter the werelion sanctum underneath Lion's Rock.You faced the mighty werelions there and one of the rare white lions even chose to accompany you.
records.name: Well Roared, Lion!

records.description: You can't keep a secret, can you? Then again, you're just fulfilling your duty to the Queen of Carlin as a lawful citizen. That's a good thing, isn't it...?
records.name: Whistle-Blower

records.description: As a true globetrotter you can now show your colours proudly with this extraordinary outfit.
records.name: Widely Travelled

records.description: Valour is for weaklings - it doesn't matter how you win the battle, as long as you're victorious. Thick armor would just hinder your movements, thus you keep it light and rely on speed and skill instead of hiding in an uncomfortable shell.
records.name: Wild Warrior

records.description: You sacrificed ingredients to create the protective brew of the witches.
records.name: Witches Lil' Helper

records.description: You like your cake soft, with fruity bits and a nice sugar icing. And you prefer to make them by yourself. Have you ever considered opening a bakery? You must be really good by now!
records.name: With a Cherry on Top

records.description: You defeated Megasylvan Yselda in the wake of the sleeping carnisylvan menace deep under Bounac.
records.name: Woodcarver

records.description: Whether it's clearing cellars from rats or delivering quara eyes with a smile, you get the job done.
records.name: Workhorse

records.description: Weehee! Whack those worms! You sure know how to handle a big hammer.
records.name: Worm Whacker

records.description: You defend Yalahar with brute force and are ready to lead it into a glorious battle, if necessary. Thanks to you, Yalahar will be powerful enough to stand up against any enemy.
records.name: Yalahari of Power

records.description: Your deeds for Yalahar are usually characterised by deep insight and thoughtful actions. Thanks to you, Yalahar might have a chance to grow peacefully and with happy people living in it.
records.name: Yalahari of Wisdom

records.description: You did not tell Jack the truth about the mistake you and Spectulus made when trying to convince him about being a completely different person. He will live in doubt until the end of his existence.
records.name: You Don't Know Jack

records.description: Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.
records.name: You Got Horse Power

records.description: You wiped Fazzrah away - zzeemzz like now you're the captain.
records.name: Zzztill Zzztanding!
